P2P baby monitor web app: WebRTC (PeerJS), Vite + TypeScript. Baby Station streams camera/mic; Parent Station receives stream.

Source:
`src/main.ts` routing/URL state; `src/baby-station.ts` camera/mic, QR/settings; `src/parent-station.ts` stream, meters, alerts/reconnection; `src/motion-detection.ts` frame differencing; `src/utils.ts` wake lock/media/audio; `src/style.css` dark theme/custom properties; `src/dictionary.ts` room IDs; `src/*.test.ts` Vitest. Playwright e2e: `tests/`; cert generation: `scripts/`; dev certs: `certs/`; assets: `public/`.

Modify camera/mic: `src/baby-station.ts`; video: `src/parent-station.ts`; utilities: `src/utils.ts`; motion: `src/motion-detection.ts`; room IDs: `src/dictionary.ts`; routing: `src/main.ts`; build/deploy: `vite.config.ts`, `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`.

Each station has `init*` returning `CleanupHandle`.
All stations MUST return `{ cleanup: () => void }` for proper teardown
Never leave MediaStream tracks running after cleanup
Never use `querySelector` without null check (use `querySelectorOrThrow`)
Don't hardcode PeerJS peer IDs in parent station (random ID, call by room)
Use `querySelectorOrThrow()` - never silently fail on missing DOM
Stations sync URL params (`station`, `roomId`); IDs: `WordWordWord1234`.
Always request wake lock on station init, release in cleanup.
Full-screen video, `.settings-drawer`; `.toast` and `.video-alert`.
Back camera prefers `facingMode: environment`; RMS uses `level * 3`; motion uses 160x120 frames and 2-second cooldown; Parent retries wait 5s+.
HTTPS: `bun run dev:https`; no separate vitest.config; Vitest only `src/*.test.ts`, Playwright `tests/` excluded via `vite.config.ts`.

bun run dev
bun run dev:https
bun run build
bun run test -- --run
bun run preview
Always use `bun test --
